markscheme.html:
12a

High temperature means that the nuclei have high kinetic energy/high speed.

During fusion a high amount of energy is required to overcome the electrostatic repulsive force between the nuclei.

12b

The energy that is released during the reaction has a mass equivalent (mass defect).

Therefore the combined mass of the deuterium and the tritium is slightly larger than the combined mass of the alpha-particle and the neutron.

a. Outline why this reaction requires extremely high temperatures.

  [2]
